name: Drawing Tablet for Omarchy
author: Alexandru Cretu
description: Map your pen tablet to the right screen and keep it there. Pick the target screen, keep the tablet's proportions or draw a custom region, flip it for left-handed use, rotate a display tablet, switch between pen and mouse mode, limit the pen's pressure range, and hide the cursor while you draw. Profiles follow the tablet by make, model and serial, and a small background service re-applies them on hotplug and after every Hyprland reload.

barWidget.description: Pen tablet mapping that survives hotplug and Hyprland reloads.
